params.name: hrtc
params.descEn: pointer to a RTC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for RTC.

functions.briefEn: Waits until the RTC registers (RTC_CNT, RTC_ALR and RTC_PRL) are synchronized with RTC APB clock.
functions.briefZh: 等待 RTC 寄存器同步完成。读写 RTC 前必须先同步，否则读数可能是旧的。
remarks: This function must be called before any read operation after an APB reset or an APB clock stop.

functions.briefZh: 写备份寄存器（复位与待机唤醒后内容保留，常用来跨复位传状态）。
